info.title: AFF Orders API
info.description: The Recipient-facing Order read/cancel endpoints (Epic D). Reflects backend/src/modules/orders/order.controller.ts::listMyOrders, ::getOrder, and ::cancelOrder as implemented. GET /orders/mine is paginated and enriched with donor/listing/live-delivery-stage per row (D5, Order/Delivery History); GET /orders/{id} and DELETE /orders/{id} return the base Order shape only — listing.name/imageUrl/unit stay omitted there, and neither returns a donor field (D5 scoped enrichment to the list endpoint only). checkout-session and payment-choice (D2/D3) are not documented here, to keep this file scoped to the read/cancel surface.

tags.name: Recipient Orders
tags.description: View and cancel the authenticated Recipient's own Orders (D4)

get.summary: List the authenticated Recipient's Orders, paginated and enriched (D5)
get.description: Always implicitly scoped to req.user.id as recipientId — there is no parameter to query anyone else's orders. Sorted newest-first (createdAt descending, no client-controlled sort). Each item embeds the donating Listing's name/imageUrl/unit, the Donor's id/companyName, and the Order's live Delivery stage (null when no Delivery exists yet, e.g. a Stripe Order still PENDING_PAYMENT) — all joined server-side so the client never needs a second call per row.

200.description: A page of the Recipient's Orders

get.summary: Get a single Order, including its live Delivery stage
get.description: Supports the order-tracking page. Ownership: the Order must belong to req.user.id. Never distinguishes a nonexistent Order from one owned by someone else — both are 404 — so this endpoint can't be used to probe for another Recipient's order ids. delivery is null when no Delivery exists yet (e.g. a Stripe Order still PENDING_PAYMENT); otherwise it reflects the Delivery's current stage, which is exactly what the client uses to decide whether to show the Cancel Order action (D4): eligible when delivery is null or stage is AWAITING_COURIER.

200.description: The Order, with its current Delivery stage embedded

delete.summary: Cancel my own Order before a Courier claims it (D4)
delete.description: Atomically checks the associated Delivery's stage. If no Delivery exists yet, or stage=AWAITING_COURIER, cancellation proceeds: ORDER.orderStatus=CANCELLED, cancelledByUserId=req.user.id, cancelledAt=now, and LISTING.quantityRemaining is restored. If stage has moved to ASSIGNED, PICKED_UP, or DELIVERED — including a Courier claim that wins the race between this endpoint's own pre-check and its atomic update — the request is rejected with 409 and the Order is left untouched; this is the same atomic-update guarantee PATCH /deliveries/{id}/claim relies on, so a claim racing a cancellation can never leave both operations believing they won. Automatic Stripe refund: if the cancelled Order has paymentMethod=STRIPE and paymentStatus=PAID, cancellation additionally triggers a synchronous stripe.refunds.create() call against PAYMENT.stripePaymentIntentId. On success, paymentStatus becomes REFUND_PENDING (not REFUNDED yet — that's confirmed later by the charge.refunded webhook, which emits payment:refunded over Socket.IO) and the response reports refundStatus=REFUND_PENDING. If the Stripe call itself errors, cancellation still commits (never blocked on Stripe reachability) and the response reports refundStatus=FAILED. Free, cash, and Stripe-but-never-paid (PENDING_PAYMENT) Orders get refundStatus=NOT_APPLICABLE and no Stripe call at all. Idempotent on the refund side: a Payment already REFUND_PENDING or REFUNDED is not refunded again.

name.description: Populated on GET /orders/mine rows; omitted on GET/DELETE /orders/{id}

imageUrl.description: Populated on GET /orders/mine rows; omitted on GET/DELETE /orders/{id}

unit.description: Populated on GET /orders/mine rows; omitted on GET/DELETE /orders/{id}

OrderDelivery.description: null when no Delivery exists yet for this Order (e.g. a Stripe Order still PENDING_PAYMENT)

RefundStatus.description: NOT_APPLICABLE: free/cash/never-paid Order, no Stripe call made. REFUND_PENDING: the synchronous stripe.refunds.create() call succeeded, awaiting the charge.refunded webhook for final confirmation (see payment:refunded, docs/api_design.md §12). FAILED: the Stripe refund call itself errored — cancellation still proceeded regardless. This is a response-only field, distinct from the persisted paymentStatus enum — NOT_APPLICABLE and FAILED never appear as ORDER.paymentStatus.

paymentMethod.description: Omitted for a free (FREE paymentStatus) Order

RecipientOrderListItem.description: GET /orders/mine returns Order plus the donating Donor's summary — not returned by GET/DELETE /orders/{id}, so it's kept as its own schema rather than added to the shared Order schema.

ValidationError.description: Query validation failed. mineOrdersQuerySchema is .strict(), so an unrecognized query parameter is also rejected.

OrderNoLongerCancellable.description: The Order's Delivery has already moved to ASSIGNED, PICKED_UP, or DELIVERED — including a Courier claim that won the race against this cancellation. The Order is left untouched.
